about: The BCU1525's LiteDRAM core, one DDR4 channel per instance (otpu_ld4; the board top instantiates it once per DIMM channel C0..C3): USPDDRPHY (LiteDRAM's UltraScale+ PHY), DDR4 x4 RDIMM (MTA18ASF2G72PZ, 16 GB, one rank, 72 bits with ECC) at sys 200 MHz = DDR4-1600, two 512-bit native user ports through LiteDRAM's ECC (the even and the odd banks, the YPCB core's contract: tools/litedram/gen_core_ddr4.py), a BIST, CSRs on an AXI-Lite slave in ctl_clk, and a VexRiscv (minimal) running LiteX's BIOS (lite console), which calibrates the channel at reset (RCD control words, write leveling, read leveling) and logs on serial_tx (115200 8N1); ready = cal_ready | the DFII's hardware control. Its clock input clk300 is the channel's 300 MHz clock on a global buffer (the top's IBUFDS + BUFG). Generated by tools/litedram/gen_core_ddr4.py; not yet run on a board (docs/bcu1525.md).

settings.toolchain: riscv64-elf-gcc 15.2.0 (Homebrew), run as riscv64-unknown-elf-* through a symlink shim (the Homebrew riscv64-unknown-elf-gcc's cc1 lacks libisl)
